messages:
maria: Quick Q 12 onboarding Arcadia POC. Need hosted API access for CI integration tests. Can we issue a scoped, short-lived API token (generate+embeddings) that expires in ~72h? They want IP allowlist + rotation cadence. CC @devin (SE).

devin: Yes. We can mint ephemeral tokens or spin up a service-account. Ephemeral 72h token is fastest. How many IPs?

maria: Three: 198.51.100.10, 198.51.100.11, 203.0.113.45. POC length 10 days. They want automated rotation every 48h and manual rotate for demos.

ashley: Security: ephemeral tokens <72h are fine for POCs. For recurring rotation or >72h, prefer service-account with KMS-managed secret. Need customer SOC contact and audit retention request.

ops-bot: /create_poc_token usage: `/create_poc_token <customer> <expiry_hours> <scopes> <ip_allowlist>`. Include metadata `poc/arcadia`. Admins only.

devin: Creating initial token now. @sam can we approve service-account fallback if they extend?

sam: Approve fallback. Note: hosted tokens are scope-limited but not model-pinned. For model pinning recommend Dedicated or pass model_version header.

jordan: I'll draft CI README for rotating env var and demo checklist.

maria: Customer contact: eng@arcadia.test. Creating ticket with required fields and requesting 72h token with the three IPs.

devin: Ran: `/create_poc_token arcadia 72 generate,embeddings 198.51.100.10,198.51.100.11,203.0.113.45`
```
Created token: ****REDACTED****
Expires: 72 hours
Audit: audit-2145001234-01
Console: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/arcadia/tokens/audit-2145001234-01
```

ops-bot: Token audit-2145001234-01 created by devin. Expires +72h. Delivered via secure DM to maria and jordan.

maria: Sending to customer via 2FA DM and attaching rotation runbook to the ticket.

jordan: Setting calendar reminder 12h before expiry for manual rotate ahead of demo.

ashley: Test revocation now to validate process.

devin: Revoking...

ops-bot: Token audit-2145001234-01 revoked by devin.

devin: Confirmed 401 on calls. Reprovisioned new token: audit-2145001234-02. Noting revocation steps in runbook.

sam: Please add curl snippets to docs and the API revocation endpoint example.

maria: Closing loop. Ticket 2145001234. I'll upload the security answers and retain logs for 90 days for this customer.
